purpose: Phase A discrimination of Rapier-driven Water displacement under the four admitted Water liquid families: collision relocation versus later liquid transport versus retained inertial state versus any true signed upward (ballistic) momentum. Observation only; no coupling, solver, bridge or default change.

world.fill: rectangle-constructed whole-cell Water, 255 quantum units per cell, identical in every arm; no normalization rule is required or applied

body.space: independent manually stepped Rapier space; exactly one Rapier step per native tick; results applied with the tick serial through the unchanged CyberRapierPhysicsBridge

arms.role: original-radius FreeMass control; not a fifth family

cases.purpose: deep, high impact, rotated and spinning asymmetric body control
wall-adjacent hard-wall containment control (body right face one cell from the wall)
bounded near-floor impact: body must reach the floor; Water must not cross the barrier

stages.1: fixture-correctness subset; stage 2 runs only if every stage-1 row passes every invariant

kinematic_probe.label: kinematic forcing experiment (prescribed body records, no Rapier dynamics); isolates the adapter relocation law, never substitutes for dynamic coupling acceptance

invariants.I1_quantity: stored Water quantity (state_a plus PressureFlow overfill) in the interior observation ROI equals the construction quantity after every relocating coupling and every tick; the complete World quantity is checked every global_stride ticks and at the final tick
invariants.I2_containment: Water quantity outside the interior ROI is zero: implied at every tick by I1 and observed directly on the complete World every global_stride ticks
invariants.I3_identity: applied family/variant/radius equals the request; backend native-phased; configured workers as requested; loaded native runtime bytes equal the recorded provenance hash; Rapier2D engine setting and server class present
invariants.I4_health: no tick failure; completed ticks equal the horizon; one Rapier manual step per tick; no stale result rejected in an ordinary run
invariants.I5_relocation_census: per-tick native BodyDisplacement events equal the coupling displaced count and equal the in-ROI destination/source grid difference
invariants.I6_carried_state: on bounded contact ticks the multiset of complete stored states of relocation sources (read before coupling) equals that of destinations (read after coupling, before the tick)
invariants.I7_inertial_domain: no inertial Water cell ever holds vy < 0
invariants.I8_mask: current-pose body mask equals the documented rasterization at sampled ticks
invariants.I9_worker_parity: for each case and arm, the configured-1 and configured-4 runs have identical trace digests, final physical state hash and coupling totals
invariants.I10_rejection: a duplicate result snapshot and an aged result are refused by the unchanged bridge (S-H-C only)
invariants.I11_body_boundary: maximum Rapier body floor penetration is reported against the retained WEX-001 two-cell characterization tolerance; not a new acceptance threshold

discriminators.D1_relocation_vs_transport: sum of positive above-surface and spray-band quantity changes attributed to relocation (B[t-1] to A[t]) versus solver transport (A[t] to B[t])
discriminators.D2_upward_relocation: BodyDisplacement events with dy < 0 versus lateral and downward
discriminators.D3_solver_rise: ticks on which the highest Water row rises during the liquid tick itself (not during coupling)
discriminators.D4_true_ballistic: a genuine ballistic launch would require signed upward retained velocity (IN vy < 0) or a flight carrier; neither exists in current source. Any spray-band Water is classified by D1-D3, never by its pixels alone
discriminators.D5_splash_shape: peak spray-band quantity and tick, peak height above the initial surface, lateral span, isolated and unsupported spray cells, return tick (censored when not returned within the horizon)

limits: Cells have no stable identity: no per-cell trajectory, launch angle or velocity is reported for FreeMass, CellularYield or PressureFlow
Destination identification is limited to the observation ROI; mismatches are reported, not repaired
Relocation distance is bounded by source (first distance ceil(penetration), then up to eight more cells along the outward normal) but per-cell distance is not exported by the adapter
The IN momentum ledger is not exported to Godot; carried-state identity uses inspect_inertial_cell tuples
Headless timings are host call durations, not displayed FPS
